_doc: Route tag -> what the road does. p = chance per journey, dc = 1d6 target to get through, fail_days = days a failure costs. A world overrides by tag in game/world/world_map.json travel.hazards or game/rules/hazards.json. foes = who stands in the road when it comes to a fight ({foe: [min, max]}, combat.spawn); also = other foes the place can ground (understand).

text.zh: 路上遇到山贼拦路,要么交买路钱,要么绕远,要么打
text.en: bandits block the road: pay the toll, take the long way round, or fight
text.ja: 山賊が道を塞いでいる。通行料を払うか、遠回りするか、戦うか

pass.zh: 山贼退了:被打退或放行,队伍继续走
pass.en: the bandits back off: beaten or bought, the party moves on
pass.ja: 山賊は引いた。撃退したか通されたか、一行は先へ進む

fail.zh: 没占到便宜:交了买路钱或绕了远路,多耗一天
fail.en: no luck: paid the toll or took the long way, one day lost
fail.ja: うまくいかない。通行料を払ったか遠回りして、一日余計にかかる

text.zh: 夜里有野兽跟着队伍,得守夜
text.en: beasts trail the party at night; someone has to keep watch
text.ja: 夜、獣が一行につきまとう。見張りが要る

pass.zh: 守夜守住了,野兽没敢近
pass.en: the watch held; the beasts kept their distance
pass.ja: 見張りが効き、獣は近寄らなかった

fail.zh: 夜里被扰,有人受了小伤,天亮才敢走,多耗一天
fail.en: a bad night, a small wound, no moving until daylight: one day lost
fail.ja: 夜を乱され軽い傷を負い、夜明けまで動けず一日遅れる

text.zh: 雾把路吞了,走岔一段,多耗了半天
text.en: fog swallows the road; the party strays for a while
text.ja: 霧が道を呑み、一行はしばらく迷う

pass.en: they find the road again without straying
pass.ja: 道を見分け、迷わずに済んだ

fail.en: they stray and lose a day
fail.ja: 道を外れ、一日余計にかかる

text.ja: 巡回隊がいて道中は平穏
